text: Great happy hour and delicious food.  Love the live music as well!
We order spring rolls, Pad Thai, and pineapple fried rice regularly and they never disappoint. We prefer to dine in, but curbside takeout is hot and ready on time.

Food was good but barley lukewarm by the time we got it home. There was no hostess and as I waited for my to go order- for which I was never greeted but ignored and had to ask for help- I saw at least one group leave because there was no one to take their name or bring them to a table. Very poorly run restaurant....

I always have a perfect dining experience...we prefer to sit at th he bar so we rarely have a wait. Our bartender's are always spot on..the food.....what can I say, it's TXRH, they cook it perfectly everytime. We like are steaks well done...the are perfectly juicy & irresistible. I like to cover mine in softened butter. OMG, com on ...I'm so ready for this. This requires so much patience ..Thank you Kelly for sharing your time with us during our lunch.
Great food, great staff! Will definitely come again! Love the music station and the different variety of pizza.

Given the restaurant's mixed reviews, I came here with an open mind.  They do not have a private lot, but there is street parking available. I placed my carry out order online and it was pretty easy.  I order some teriyaki wings, a meatatarian pizza, some cheesy bread, basco bread and a cannoli. The wings were large and tasted ok.  I would not put them in the top tier of wing I have eaten or anything.  The pizza was the same, ok.  The crust and sauce were tasty, but as a whole it did not hit the mark. I would like to tell you about the cannoli, but it was left out off my order. I was already home, by he time I discovered it was missing and did not feel like going all the way back.  Note to self, check carry out order before I leave the restaurant.   They do have a nice dinning area that you can eat in and the staff there is very friendly.

We are hoping the reviews on the St Louis ribs are wrong because my husband is looking forward to them. I'll update the post shortly!
Update! 
Good food great service  we will definitely be back!

Best Pho place in Reno hands down! Has the best flavor out of every other place I've tried. Meat is tender, veggies are fresh, and broth is flavorful. Never disappointed with their service or their food!

We had 2 good meals and one very poor. The 2 different trout dishes were very good while the shrimp dish would be what is expected day after at a fast food restaurant. It was over breaded and very dry. Batting 660 in baseball would be great but when spending for a meal is disappointing especially for one ordering the shrimp.

Checked out a new breakfast place this morning and boy did we enjoy it! We arrived on a Sunday morning around 9am and the place was packed. We had about a 10 minute wait and the nice thing was that they provided free self-serve coffee while you waited.  We were seated within the wait time given and our waitress quickly came over to greet us and take our drink orders. So many delicious sounding items on the menu but my wife went with the Farmhouse Hash while I went with the Floridian French Toast. My two boys had pancakes (one Lemon Ricotta and the other chocolate chip). We should have ordered off the kids menu for our littler one as the regular size pancakes cover an entire plate and there's two of them. Everything was so fresh and delicious but it was a lot of food. I was done eating for the day after this meal. We also got their million dollar bacon which I could have eaten all day!! They provided a carafe of coffee at our table so we could easily refill our coffee whenever we wanted. Both of my boys enjoyed their hot chocolate with whip cream and my wife also got the Morning Meditation Fresh Juice, which was a concoction of orange, lemon, ginger, beet, and agave nectar. Very refreshing!! Overall, we really enjoyed our breakfast here but it was definitely a pricey breakfast. For the four of us with tip, we hit the $100 mark. I would like to see smaller portion sizes with smaller prices to go along with that. We will definitely be back, but given the prices, it's not a place

The staff and chef were some of the nicest people in Nashville! 

The restaurant itself was like 80% there, I loved the view as you walk in, but the large TV behind the bar totally ruined the speak easy dark moody vibe. And the decor really didn't push it in one direction far enough. 

The food, I ordered the rabbit rolls, and to be honest they were ok. They are mostly spam sliders. The meat had a salty, spam texture and heavy pork taste. Not any rabbit/ or gamey type taste or flavor to them. Also, the bread was just a basic Hawaiian roll, and there were sautéed onions with a cheese type sauce. I did eat them, and they weren't bad at all. But should have been 8$ as they were. My thoughts were, 1 why use cheap Hawaiian rolls, when you have a 30 year old sourdough starter, and some of the best sourdough outside of The Bay Area. Make these with more rabbit, use sourdough and make little buns. That way, the sourdough cuts through the salty heaviness of meat and sauce. The other food we ordered was the gnocchi. And to be honest it was darn good. It was a tad too soft, and probably over boiled. But the sauce was fantastic. And would order them again. 

The best thing you can order, is there the sourdough bread. It was honestly amazing, and the chef and I talked about it, and it made up for the less than great food and drinks we had. 

Now, the drinks were great, but not anything to write home about. My expectations of this "highly rated," Nashville hot spot were left with a lot of
We've always had nothing but the best service & delicious meals. Tonight's take out was no exception.:

decided to give this yiro yiro location a shot hoping ot would be faster and more convenient than the west philly location. I waited till i arrived at the restaurant to see if it was crowded and it wasn't so I phoned in my order from the car. the wait was short and reasonable, maybe ten mins or so. staff was friendly but they forgot to put utensils in my bag. no big deal. i ordered a beef gyro, a pork belly gyro and rice pilaf. as ive said before, their gryos are just a bit less authentic than what I'm used to. the flavor just seems to be missing something. the food isnt bad but just different I suppose. i will say this, they give you a very nice portion of food for your money. the servings are filling for sure. another huge plus is the rear parking lot. great place to chill and eat in your car if you're on the go.

I'll start by saying that everything we had was good. The group of us got a few apps (shishito peppers, Chinese broccoli, and pork gyoza), and a few types of ramen (short rib and crispy duck). The two star review is strictly based on service...

We got to the restaurant just after 6pm on a Sunday evening. Took a few minutes for our server to come take our order...fine. Ordered apps, dinner, and drinks. Drinks took about 30 minutes to come. The apps came on at a time; by 7pm we had only gotten two of them. Our waiter stopped by and we asked about the third one we were waiting on, to which is responded that the kitchen was having issues printing ticket orders and it must have gotten missed. An additional 20 minutes and those finally came out. Around 7:15, a couple came in and sat next to us, and we joked that they'd get their ramen before we would. And sure enough- they did! Ramen came about 7:40. 

After all this, we asked to speak to the manager, and he graciously offered to take 50%  off of our bill. When he came back, my husband picked up all 3 tabs- only two of which had actually been reduced. Not wanting to spend another minute in this place, my husband left and my friend gave the manager a piece of her mind about not upholding his end of the deal. 

We aren't from the area, but rest assured we would never step foot in this place again if we were.

I order from them all the time and they consistently go back and forth on whether or not that want to serve the tostado's as a single order or a order of 3. Mind you they have a price for a single tostado ($3.50). Sometimes you can get a single one and other times they say they don't sell them that way. Why do you have a price for something if you don't sell it that way?!?! If I'm ordering a bunch of food from you, why would you not let me add a single tostado?! I don't want 3! I just ordered a bunch of other stuff.  This is the third time I've been told this! Mind you, in between these times I have ordered a single tostado with the rest of my order.

Horrible service. Had to go and get our drinks because our waiter was to busy making alcoholic drinks. When the food came out it was not hot. They did not get my husbands order correct. They brought hash browns instead of grits. Very disappointing. 
Waiter was to busy taking care of a bigger group. 
Very disappointing.

Can't wait to go back! For my very first visit I had the half/half- half a turkey club and a cup of tomato basil soup. Both were amazing. Shared the fries + secret sauce with my husband and we enjoyed those as well. Already looking at when I'll go back and what I'll try next!

This place was so yummy! Came here around 9:30 on a Wednesday morning and they had about two tables . Menu is not too big, it has just the right amount of food. We decided to go with the jefe omelette which cOnsisted of avocado, sour cream, choRizo, black beans and salsa! I love tacos so this was perfect! It came with hash browns but in my opinion they were a tab bit too salty. We also ended up getting a side of biscuits and gravy. Now normally I don't like gravy, but you MUST get this gravy it was truly delicious! Our food  came out within aBout 10 min! So fast! Everyone there was friendly, price was reasonable and it wasn't chaotic! I can't wait to go  back and try some more items on this menu! My only suggestion is a little less salt for the hash browns please . Also I was able to split this omelette ! It's a good amount of food!

Warning!!! That Giant Margarita Costs $50!!!! We had no idea!!! $29 for a pitcher!!! We are locals and had no idea their prices were crazy!! We did like the flour tortilla chips, food was so-so.  We have gone 3 other times and never ripped off like this-the waitress was so worried about the cameras and carding everyone-we are 56 years old...lol ....def. something sketchy going on here.

Nicole salad was the best I've had. And the cherry desert. Also the soups were amazing.
Ambiance excellent along with maintaining covid regulations.

I eat here whenever I get up this way. I was here for lunch a couple weeks ago for dine in. The food was good, but they weren't really keeping the bar up (not surprising with covid limitations) but they offered to make us anything on the bar fresh OR EVEN OFF THE MENU. What a deal!

Let's put it this way, I drive from Baltimore to Philadelphia once maybe twice a month just to get my hands on these delicious BBQBeef Ribs.  But nothing you order could you possibly be disappointed with
I got the Vietnamese coffee and the apple cinnamon crunch donut and both were so good! I am not even a big donut fan but this place is great.

Nice atmosphere, above average cocktails.  I have been 2 times and on both occasions found the food to be  good but nothing that really impressed me. My wife really enjoyed the cauliflower. I had the burger and the French dip. I will go back since I live nearby.

This review is only for their drinks. I stopped by to grab a drink before dinner. I sat at the bar and waited 10 mins for the bartender finally got to take my order. I tried to pop star and my friend tried mule, which were what the bartender recommended as the most popular drinks there. What a disappointment! The pop star tasted just like sugar with water, and the mule tasted like lime with water. Neither me nor my friend finished our drinks - yes, it was that bad! 
The 2 stars are for the ambiance! It's a very cool and inclusive restaurant. Very unique dive bar. I might go back to try their food, but no drinks. No, no no!

I don't know if it was just my excitement to be back at a restaurant (and not eating take-out at home), but Chestnut Grill was awesome yesterday. They had a ton of great beers on tap so we started off with a few of those. My partner and I weren't too hungry, so we split the Ultimate Burger which was plenty for both of us. It was SO GOOD (though a bit overcooked), but we didn't care. The fries were seasoned perfectly and the portions were solid. For $16 it was a bit steep for a burger and fries, but it was so worth it. The best part of all - every other spot in the area requires reservations for outdoor dining, but Chestnut Grill is first-come, first-serve so we walked up and were seated right away. We will be back!
Best Nicos burrito takeout in Tucson.  Been going for years and the whole menu is great.  Their breakfast burritos are a must try, and the people working there are always cool.

Burger was delicious! I just had the plain burger with bacon. I asked for it to be cooked medium and it was done perfectly. The burger came with a stuffed potato skins which was very good as well. Staff was very friendly and attentive. I need to come back to try the gumbo and pizza!
I love this place! This one of my favorite places to eat.Great food. Great service. It's healthy. veg-friendly and healthy. It is a hidden gem in The Garden District.

Love, love this place. Such a welcoming environment with a great staff that are always happy to see you walking in. The new place has been quite busy with a wait at times but it's worth it for the delicious food. It's a bit up in price but for getting hand made tossed pizza and their many other items on the menu it's worth the wait.

Let me just start out at saying WOW! The brisket platter came with two sides Mac and cheese and bbq beans (no ordinary sides) very amazing down to the last crumb of cornbread! I ordered the hot tacos and they were definitely spicy even w/o the jalapeño ranch sauce. The fried pickles were a big hit even with my non vegetable eater (7 year old). My kids ordered the kids corn dogs and their only complaint was that one order was not enough for them. Definitely recommend and if I ever visit the area again I will be back.

We had been looking forward to eating at this establishment for several months now and so we decided to go on Valentine's Day so off we go. We walked  in and no one greeted us so I asked a fellow customer what the process was and he stated they told him to stand by the door and wait. My wife and I went over and sat on a bench for about 10 minutes at which point a lady came up and asked us if we had reservations and I said not yet. She walked away without saying anything and then she came back with a paper table cover and said they only had table tops.  The whole conversation was weird but okay we were seated and then reviewed the menu.  Our waiter came over after about 10 minutes and took our drink order. He came back in ten minutes with our drinks and proceeded to take our food order. My wife ordered the Skinny Dip Chicken and I ordered the Delmonico ribeye with a side salad. The waiter asked what Temp I wanted the steak cooked to and said medium and I wanted my salad before my meal. Well, we waited about 30 minutes for our food to come. When it finally came, the skinny dip chicken was a red rock chicken sandwich and my steak which was supposed to be medium was still mooing. My wife reordered the originally ordered skinny dip chicken while I ate the outer part of my cow I mean steak along with my salad that was supposed to come before my steak. I don't send food back because I know it pisses off cooks when you do this so I didn't want my cow dipped in the ole honey pot. Need

Terrible RUDE service...Basically NO service at all!!! They walked past me nimerous times without even acknowledging my presence then flippantly told ke if I need to order tahe I am going have to wait. They appear to make money selling alcohol and not food.
Would give this place five stars for the food--I have always had excellent sandwiches here--but I have to give one star because they don't wear masks. That is a deal breaker for me.

Worst place ever.just had Steak 'n Shake for the first time and it was just horrible.ordered 2 burgers and a shake and cost be 24 dollars.really?24 dollars? Food took about 25 mins to get out the window and the sake was melted and really watery,when I pulled off to check my burgers it was cold already.I don't understand how it's cold when it took 25 mins to make.all in all never going back again worst burger place ever

Located inside the Baum Market....their savory tarts and a cup of coffee....an uplifting experience no matter how you feel ...the sweeter items....not too sweet but still covers all my sweet tooth bases ...with a dbl espresso.     

Their breakfast sandwiches...have tried all 3....and all 3 all good...just depends on your taste and mood...My fav is the vegan maple chick, hashbrown on a buttermilk biscuit and with a cup of coffee!   

Good spot for sure!

Really cool take on Asian cuisine. The inside of the restaurant is also very pretty. They have very good vegetarian options and a great drink selection. The edamame dumplings and kimchi fried rice are my favorites from here. Also check out the outdoor bar called graffiti. Really cool vibe plus you can get most of the food there too!

I have never been inside this place but actually discovered it during covid through uber eats. Once I'm ready to go back to going out to eat, they will be one of the first on my list. When food is still good after delivery, you know they're doing things right. Even fried food is excellent here whereas usually when you get something fried delivered it's soggy and greasy.  Highly recommend their popcorn shrimp, crab cakes, key lime pie and the list goes on. Somehow they even make broccoli that makes my mouth water!  I've now ordered from them about a half dozen times and they have yet to disappoint. Great job you guys!  I know how difficult it is to operate in the world of COVID, I work retail, and you guys are really killing it!  Thank you!!!

Here on vacation and I heard that these were the best po-boys in town. (Let the arguments begin) I will say I have had my fair share of po-boys coming from ATX and while I did enjoy the shrimp po-boy there was no wow factor about it. Now the Johnnys special! Was AMAZING! The gravy was enough to make me want to try this place again for sure.

The owners and staff really look after you once you are seated. It's reputation for great comfort food is well deserved. Everyone in our party of five were very happy with their meals. I can't wait to be off my diet so I can go back and have some biscuits.

Amazing brunch!  Loved the mimosas with my trout Benedict!  We sat outside with our large party and the patio was fabulous!  It was perfect weather, but if it were to get chilly we had heaters all around us!

My mother and I came here today after our power went out and we weren't able to finish cooking dinner. We walked up and a sign stated "seat yourself" so we sat down at an open table. There were plenty of people enjoying their meals and getting checked on by staff. We sat for 20 mins and no one ever came to our table so my mom went inside to see why no one came to wait on us; she was told the kitchen closed. I know there were plenty of staff that saw us walk up and sit down and not one even acknowledged us. Totally unacceptable! There was a man who walked in literally 30 seconds before us and was able to receive service. Someone should have given us a heads up instead letting us sit there making a fool out of ourselves and wasting our time. I bet if we walked up with food from another establishment and sat down someone would've called us out for sure. Very upsetting!

I've gone to this establishment at least a handful of times and I've never been dissatisfied until today. I ordered chicken potstickers which were cold when they arrived, but the sauces were good. I also ordered the crawfish jambalaya and it was the most bland and dry jambalaya I have ever tasted. I couldn't even finish the entree because it was that distasteful. I don't recommend it at all. They definitely need to add more seasoning and sauce. I don't think I'll be ordering from here anytime soon.

Pat's pizza is just the worst establishment in phoenixville I don't know why I continue to bother with them. This time it's 10:10 I called to order food and they tell me they are closed that it had been dead all day and they wanted to leave. Wouldn't a business that has been slow all day want to capitalize on a sale and make some money, just doesn't make sense granted it was 20 min before closing but common guys. Not my first bad experience with this place I have lived in phoenixville for 5 years now and I gotta tell you stay away from here, save the headache.

Food Service and Atmosphere

My wife and I are down to watch the Cowboys lose to WhoDatNation and came by Morrows. OMG what  a time, what a time. The food was out of this world, the atmosphere was amazing, and Jimmy and Carlimacc at the bar are A plus with a Big Stamp of Approval. We will be back.

Had a work wonderful evening here the other night. You're definitely going need a reservation came here on a Thursday night but did not wait long got seated at our table and was greeted right away. We opted for the large seafood tower which came with king crab legs, lobster, shrimp, and poki. The lobster bisque was on point. On top of that I went with the tomahawk ribeye 35 ounce steak and lobster tail. For the sides we had mac & cheese asparagus, and  the au gratin potatoes. All delicious. For desert I stuck with the classic cheesecake. Trust me that I didn't finish this all in one sitting. Definitely took home what I couldn't finish. The entire dining experience lasted 2 hours and was not cheap. But definitely worth it!!

On June 8, I ordered the 16 piece meal for my family via the web.  Order # 645728221 for a cost of $45.49.

We picked it up from inside the store and brought it home.

It was badly burned.  Charred.  Most pieces were inedible and had to be thrown away.

I e-mailed the El Pollo website to ask for some kind of refund and never heard back from them.

Never going back again.

Awful food.  Wasted money.  No company response.

We always go for the limit two margaritas and stay for the street tacos! Canyon cafe is one of my personal favorites, you can never have to much of their chips and salsa and my favorite combination of their street tacos are the bison, al pastor, and crispy chicken! Everything on their menu tastes amazing and we are never disappointed! They atmosphere and the staff are very friendly

Best food. Best service. Best price. 

I have been living in Clearwater for 7 years now and I've been to countless sushi restaurants in all of Tampa bay and I can confidently say Ken Sushi is the best there is. Their food is consistently delicious and high quality along side with their costumer service. After years of being a regular at Ken's, I don't have a single complaint. Not once was I given the wrong order or received by a rude waiter. 

The place has always been clean but now especially during the pandemic, they have rapidly adapted their service to make sure customers like myself are still getting their food quickly and safely. All staff members are wearing masks. You can still dine in but if you rather order take out they have a separate door where you are given your food and they have two separate "clean" and "used" pen cups for signing the check on your way out. 

It's the best spot to get some quick takeout for a date night or enjoy a nice lunch with friends. It is well deserved of 5 stars.

If you like being spoken to like a child than this is the place for you. The so called manager Rory spoke to me like I was five, did nothing about the 40 minutes extra wait time and insisted that I received an email when I repeatedly told her I did not. There's a reason why I coordinated pick up times based on information quoted. Not because I wanted to wait forty unnecessary minutes and have other food get cold. Not to mention the man who brings me my order drops the order and ran away from me when I asked for his name. The parking lot was a sheet of ice with absolutely no treatment done to it.
Don't get delivery. It came 25 min late and was cold and missing the Marinara sauce we ordered. A "large" pizza (pretty small/medium in any other place) for $30+......pass.

Good Vietnamese Pho Soup in Reno! We were in search of a good soup place after a long day of casino hopping and found this gem! Good food and very friendly staff! Unfortunately they have limited seating at this time due to the pandemic but it is worth the wait! The servers are extra attentive and very nice. You can tell that they are grateful for customers that are patiently waiting!

The corn muffins were very dry and did not taste good. The shrimp was average, and it tasted like frozen shrimp from a bag. All the food in general served at our table seemed old and just heated up for us. However, the service was really great, and the waitress was nice. I will not be coming here again.
Worst stromboli I ever had! I ordered a cheesesteak stromboli with everything and got a cheese and mushroom instead then the cheese and doe on the inside was still raw ‍
Service was outstanding. Food was delicious and unusual. Very clean. Accessing parking lot was different.

Large venue slightly off the beaten path that is the Broadway bachelorette party tourist trap. Large indoor area with live music and moonshine store (and yes, you can also buy merchandise which sort of makes it a little touristy). A couple on-site food vendors, large outdoor area, friendly staff. We've been to Nashville lots of times but this was our first time here thanks to the Covid restrictions which ade it one of the few places that were open. Will definitely come back.

The bottom line: if you want to take a break from the masses on Broadway you should come check this place out. On site food vendors, decent cocktails and beers (limited to their own brands).

Missing a good crepe and they didn't disappoint.   Had the savory with spinach, mushroom,  egg and brie.  I was very happy with it.   Made to order so it's fresh and warm.   The sweet crepe are my next visit.   You gotta try it.

This is my very first time writing a review on Yelp because I wanna express my fantastic experience with Salt and Smoke. 
We went all the way from Tennessee to St. Louis for Six Flag and after that, we wanted to try local food. Thanks God we found Salt and Smoke. The atmosphere is great and we were so pleased with the food. We had Bestie Combo with pulled pork and chicken. A MUST TRY is Mac n Cheese, its awesome!!!
Our waitress is Ms. Liz (I guess), she is great.

There are not enough good words in my vocabulary to tell you how impressed I am with the food and the service. I waited for so so long for it to open and then after it opened I never came until today, this was my first time and I can assure you it will not be my last.
Now for what I did not like but it will not make me take a star away. They have started automatically adding a gratuity of 15% to all checks. I always tip at least 20% and sometimes 30% so that in itself I do not mind however when you get the check the 15% is listed as a service charge, not gratuity so I have no idea if the servers actually get that or not, Although I'm pretty confident that they do... I mean who would pull that kind of crap right?  Then the suggested percentages at the bottom do not take into account that 15% has already been added so if you aren't paying attention and you want to tip 20% You may very well end up tipping 35%... So I deducted the 15% that they added ($10.05) from the suggested 20% ($13.40) So I ended up writing a net additional tip of $3.35 (which kinda made me feel like an ass on such a large bill and needing to explain myself to the server) it's an uncomfortable feeling I don't want to experience when dining out and hope they do something else or it could put a wrench in my plans of going here often!
Oh... the bartender Adrianna was awesome.

This place makes Subway and Jimmy Johns taste like dog feces. Don't care if it's a chain, it doesn't feel like it at all. these are the best sandwiches in the nation. Anyone who has spent any time in Philly is already aware, just had to let it be known for people coming from out of town. Be prepared for a juicy meat filled savory sandwich of your choice with fresh ingredients on an excellent roll. It will leave you full and satisfied guarantee. The oil really sets it off.

I was in Santa Barbara picking something up for a family member and luckily saw this place was open during the quarantine! I decided to get the Venetian sandwich, and my boyfriend got the breakfast one. Lemme just say, I'm not usually a tomato person when it comes to sandwiches, but here they do something different! I appreciate that they are roasted and thin sliced as opposed to the thick sliced raw tomatoes other sandwich places offer. The Venetian was a really good sized sandwich, but I managed to chow it down in five minutes it was so good. The guy at the front counter was super friendly, and I would definitely pick this restaurant again next time I'm in the area.

A great place for a quick bite to eat that isn't super overcrowded! The parking is a little tricky, there's a parking garage next to the restaurant and it's $6. Our waitress was super kind and got everything correct, and even brought a few things (like ranch) before I had to ask. 

My husband ordered the 90210 burger and Cajun fries and really enjoyed it. Definitely recommend the Cajun fries and they were super crispy. I ordered a side of tater tots with bacon and cheese. I was pleasantly surprised that the tots were situated in a bowl of cheese- and not the spicy nacho kind of cheese. Perfect- liquid gold cheese. We ordered the corn dog nuggets and they were great!

This place was exactly as fellow Yelpers depicted it.  They also had a great music selection playing.

Ummm....who is in charge of answering phones because all she said was " may I place you on a brief hold?" And never came back??? This was the second time I called too! First call was 15min then this? Absolutely unacceptable for any business! This is a longer wait then the DMV? So disappointed, hire a better person on register because she was horrible at managing people in line and on the phone!

My son and I accidentally wandered into Tortorice's while looking for a Philly Cheese Steak sandwich. Best. Mistake. Ever. Tortorice's doesn't have cheese steak, but they do have the most fabulous, authentic, gorgeous, delicious Italian sandwiches on this side of Atlantic. I had the tuna wrap and it was out of this world. Super high-quality, imported tuna, light seasonings and olive oil, so may mouth-watering veggies, my stomach is grumbling just thinking about it! No mayo. This was gourmet all the way. My son had the Broad Street Bully and he loved it. William, the owner, is very personable and kind. Great neighborhood vibe, incredibly high quality bread and meats - heck, all the ingredients are top-notch! Do yourself a favor and try this place.

This place looked good from the pictures and reviews were great. It took 2 hours to get a cheese pizza and I didn't get my salad until I left. The waitress said they're a bit backed up so I figured maybe 45 min for my pizza... there were less than 20 customers and some had already gotten food. This place isn't worth your time or money. The pizza was mediocre, sandwich and pizza from my friends got worse feedback, and there was hardly anyone there. Biggest problem was the chef couldn't handle a few simple orders... cheese pizza and a margherita in a place that has pizza in it's name. What a waste.

Quaint restaurant on South Street in the Fitler Square area.

I absolutely love this place because it's one of the restaurants in the city that serves  breakfast/brunch food round the clock until 10PM which is when they close (open pretty late!!). It's also BYO by the way.

The staff were extremely friendly and accommodating, and helped choose since the menu got so many good listings it kind of is hard to choose. 

I personally tried the Honey Cristo. Excellent challan toast with Lancaster cheese and ham.The fries are bottomless too!

The restaurant also has a great quiet vibe, with not too many people and a very artsy decor!

Only qualm/pointer to remember is : CASH ONLY. Nonetheles, there's a Wawa right nearby that has a surcharge free ATM.

Was too famished to take a picture of the food, so here's a picture of the restaurant from where I was seated.
Avoid the burgers, they are flavorless and basically just a loaf of bread. Hot and honey wings get an A++

The food is great and we have been supporting this place since it is locally owned and operated. Truly, we order from here 2-4 times a month. However, tonight I was disappointed in the pick up process and the portion of queso we received. There were three people in front of me waiting to pick up their orders, but no one but the cooks were handing out the orders that were sitting there. Only when a cook had time to turn around and pay attention, did he start handing out orders that were sitting there.  You need a better system CT! Also, they skimped big time on the amount of queso we got in the regular size! Enough for one person, not 2 to enjoy. Nothing like feeling ripped off when you get home to see your order. We'll keep ordering, but will definitely check my order before leaving the store.

This was a wonderful vegan restaurant to visit while in St Louis. They had outdoor seating with heat lamps set up, and it was very comfortable and felt much safer Covid-wise than eating indoors (though we were surprisingly the only ones out there!) The server was lovely to chat with and informative about the menu. Everything is made in house. 

The cocktails were excellent as were the appetizers-- crab Rangoon and hush puppies. I even had to ask if the crab rangoon was vegan as it tasted so much like the real thing. 

I highly recommend Tree House to vegans and non-vegans alike!

This is a two-fer review. The first experience was SECOND TO NONE!!! Last Saturday, a friend and I were trying to order sushi online. Uber Eats/DoorDash/etc don't list all that's actually on a menu. My friend wanted one thing, I wanted escolar. We spoke with Kory. He was BEYOND amazing! He told us over the phone what to order on the delivery app that would match the price for what we really wanted from the restaurant. It was seamless! Everything arrived as expected. Additionally, Kory texted to make sure all was acceptable. He is an asset to Virago (M Street)! He TOTALLY went above and beyond. So... fast forward to tonight. Not a Saturday as before, but a Thursday. A female answered. I asked for Kory. She said there is no one by that name here. I kindly asked to speak with a manager. Jacob comes on the line. I explained to him how much Kory helped with the delivery app on a SATURDAY NIGHT, but he said that they couldn't assist on a THURSDAY NIGHT. He said they were too busy. So, I said, okay, I totally I understand... you guys are busy. I said, "I'm thinking there is another sushi place that serves escolar..." (giving Jacob a chance to redeem himself). He responds with a "have a good night and good luck".

Anthony's Chophouse is located in a lower floor of the Nugget Casino in Sparks. It was recently extensively renovated to accommodate the new upscale restaurant and it is quite pleasant and comfortable.
Our wait was short and 5 minutes before our reservation time we were escorted to our table. Service was excellent and our waiter, Oscar, was very attentive to our needs.
The bread was warm, fresh and tasty, and several different flavors were woven into one pull-apart style roll. So good! I love good bread. It was served with butter rather than oil and vinegar, I suspect due to the current covid concessions.
When our salad arrived, my wife and I both shrieked that we had forgotten to specify Iceberg or Romaine lettuce when we saw the rabbit food lettuce. We almost sent it back but given it would only be trashed, we elected to try it. Despite our misgivings, it was so much better than any other spring mix salad we have ever eaten, no tart notes and the dressings were superb. I suspect the Spring Mix is a concession to our tourists.
I ordered the surf and turf special. The steak was huge and heavily marbled; not usually what I would preferentially select, but it was amazingly tasty. Too much fat for my typical steak, but I couldn't fault either the taste or the preparation. The shrimp were perhaps the best blackened I have tasted. They were perfect! Very flavorful with no edge of burnt flavors.
My wife ordered fish cooked to perfection with a very nice sauce to increase the flavor

The food was good, so overall it's worth a plate. The issue we had was with the wait and management. 

We went on a Sunday morning, and the wait was about 20 min, so we were good with that. We waited inside as my wife is 8 months pregnant and it's 90 outside. We were standing by a table that was dirty. The manager in a Purple shirt, came by and in a rude fashion, told us we needed to move. He said we could stand outside as they have a PA. Again, it was 90 degrees, but that's beside the point as there were literally 9 dirty tables around the restaurant. 9 table and about 4 couples waiting??

Suggestion: The manager should have taken ownership, cleaned tables, sat people, and then got their drink orders. Instead he was more worried about the one table we stood next to. 

We almost left but decided to stay, the food was good, but the manager needs training in hospitality.
Incredible food. Loved the chicken and Mac n cheese.

Great tasting food for an awesome price. They have solid vegetarian options. I have always gotten the bowls here and ordered in person and through uber eats many times. The only thing I would tell them to improve is that I liked the way the cooked the tofu previously. Recently, it was a little more deep fried (crusty feel). You can taste the french fry like flavor bleeding into the different sauces. I loved the old way they made the tofu--still semi soft, lightly pan fried. I would highly recommend this place for a lunch, or a quick spot to grab a casual/cheap meal.
Awesome bakery took my kids here they absolutely loved it just wish they would stay open later cookies was amazing Fruitloop donuts was absolutely to die for great place

Rocco's is a legitimately great steakhouse. I have been here twice visiting my cousin and the experience was phenomenal both times. I definitely recommend the seafood tower and crispy [fried calamari] for appetizers. The tower is plentiful, fresh, delicious. I love the raw oysters and clams, scallop crudo, and blue crab meat. The sauces are also great. In particular, the scallop crudo is ridiculously good. Crab legs and shrimp are also on the tower but I do not eat them. Moreover, the crispy calamari is awesome. My 6 year old nephew specifically asked to go to Rocco's for his birthday just because of the calamari.

Of course, the steaks are great too. I have had the porterhouse and the Kansas City strip steak. I have gotten them medium rare and they have been juicy and chewy just the way I like my steak. I also recommend adding two Maryland crab cakes for $12. The crab meat is fresh and definitely from Maryland. The cakes do include some stuffing. Although the stuffing is very good, I still prefer crab cakes with all crab. Personally, one crab cake with pure crab would be better than two with a little stuffing as filler. Nonetheless, the cakes were great. Overall, Rocco's has become one of my favorite steakhouses anywhere.

Made the trip to The Loveless Cafe on the way to a volleyball tournament in Nashville. Amazingly, no wait on a Friday night, which makes this the first time because this place is usually very busy. Lucky us.

At any rate, if you're reading this, there is a good chance you've heard of Loveless, because it is famous for its biscuits. If you haven't heard of this place, get off at exit 192 on I-40, head south for 5 minutes and take a left at the light. Great food. Biscuits and homemade jams that will leave you speechless--PRO TIP: ask for honey with your biscuits. Great gift shop to purchase said jams and other delicious treats. Just a fun place to eat and hang out for a minute. And the desserts? Oh yeah...they have desserts. They. Have. Desserts.

Great place for some home style food , the fried chicken was phenomenal and there are no words to explain how good the green beans are . I ate the  mash potatoes with gravy and it's like I died and came back a new person .  
 Romel our waiter was great to us and made us feel like we were at home .   He made us laugh and then gave us some of the very best food New Orleans had to offer.   I proudly give this restaurant 5 solid stars cause I meant it and I'll represent it !

This used to be an amazing place with great food for a bit of a bumped price but now it is severely overpriced. The menu they had online listed a burger with fries and a wagyu flank steak with asparagus and fries. The steak was $26 on the menu, so I called and placed the order. My total after burger steak and short rib mac and cheese was $70. For $70 guess what? Now everything is a la carte even though they didn't update the menu so I show up and its just a tiny steak no sides and the new price is $31??? So 6 dollars more and no sides, awesome. No fries with the burger either. Complete ripoff now its not good enough to charge me $100 for two people and one of the people got a burger.

My wife and I went there last night and really enjoyed it. It was some of the best Ramen I had in a  longtime. We also had a king crab sushi roll , it was so good we ordered another to go. I will differently go back for another visit.

We love Elmers! Definitely is a place we visit every time we come to Boise. We love their cinnamon roll pancakes and their breakfast platters! Great fast service and we love the homey feel of the restaurant. Thanks Elmers!

After a long flight, came here to get some hot food- thinking it should be safe given its right out of the oven. NOT ONE employee was wearing a mask! Well, one was, but it was around his neck, below his chin. As far as I could tell, he wasn't breathing through a tracheotomy. Are these people oblivious, stupid or just plain jackasses? These are exactly the kind of people that are dying at the hospital I work at. Doesn't St Louis have an order to wear a mask in public during this severe health crisis??? Anyway, I learned my lesson about thinking a piping hot pizza might be a safe option while traveling.
Relaxed atmosphere and enjoyable beer. Food was also solid but nothing overly crazy and or exciting.
Worst onion rings i have ever had in my life.way over cooked.Spent way too much for a burger & onion rings.First & LAST VISIT.

You can get some unique and cleverly named speciality pizza here, like The Situation, Philly Cheese Steak, .38 Special, and Lasagna. Good crust, good quality toppings, and they don't skim on cheese. 
As of yesterday 5/17 it's still takeout and delivery only (within 8 miles). I appreciate the owners doing this to keep the community safe! They have online ordering but if you call you get 15% off. I suggest checking its social media pages for updates.

So the first McDonalds we went to messed up my order. By the time we noticed it we were too far to turn back. Hubby decided we would stop here to get my breakfast.  It was nearly 10am, didn't expect the backup that was here.
Got into the drive thru but the line didn't move at all. Hubby decided to go inside instead.  Staff was rude and non professional.  Took forever to get our small order.
The food was ok but not worth the wait and whatever was up with the drive thru. Don't think we will be returning here.

Their website still doesn't recognize the Canal Street, Metairie, or MSY airport locations, so I was unable to order online and pick up in store, but it wasn't a big deal because there was no lunch rush on this Monday.
Hopefully, it is just a matter of time before that is squared away, and I can walk downstairs from my office building, to pick up and go.
Working in Canal Place office building, Shake Shack is a god sent! The lunch options were pretty lacking, especially when I didn't want to walk far.

Like the majority of other locations, this Shake Shack utilizes the self serve checkout stations that are credit, debit card, and mobile payment friendly, but a few stations were down one week after opening. For those with cash, and need assistance, you can still checkout with the cashier.
There is no street parking nearby, since this is borders downtown/French Quarter --so, it's good if you're already in the area on foot.
Quality and service here is standard and the crinkle cut fries are still crisp and delicious!
There's a local touch with Abita root beer and alcoholic beers along Willa Jean cookies.
Wow this place is awesome. Basically like a better version if Panera with better pricing homemade soups and specials daily, great salad selections and sides too. I will be back every week for sure.
Excellent food but I've had some weird encounters with the hostess (like showing up at my reservation time and having to wait 15+ minutes on a few occasions or simply dealing with rude people)

The food was SO GOOD. Made PERFECTLY! We had the pot stickers to start and i had the penne rose and my boyfriend had the pad Thai. Delicious. And the staff was incredibly friendly :) can't wait to come back!!

We went on Valentine's Day for a family dinner. The guest room was to cold and the seating was very close to each other. Lots of activity what does not helped for a relaxed enjoyable atmosphere. Everytime a customer left or came in the restaurant we could feel the cold air in the dinning area. The food was ok, in my opinion a little over priced. The mixed drinks and deserts where fantastic. The waiter was doing an excellent job. I would not go again in a short period of time.

We recently weren't to Mel's for some take out.
The service was fast and the hot dogs were fantastic.
I ordered the Chicago Dog and a Fire Dog. Both were great but the Fire Dog was my favorite or the two. I liked the heat from the peppers and the snap from the hot dog. Perfect bite.
I will def go back.

Went on 9/6/2020 with my gf for lunch. Today is also my birthday. We are from Ohio visiting my daughter. 

Sat outside as it was a pleasant weather afternoon. Was seated by a nice young lady. And Dave was our server. Dave was on point our entire visit. So he gets 5 stars. I ordered the Breuben and fries. Food came quickly. Proportions were bigger than I had imagined. The fries were really, really good. The sandwich itself was phenomenal. The toasted icky bread is a thing of beauty and perfect taste. The beer wasn't bad. I'm a bit of a beer snob so sometimes I judge too harshly. This visit gets 5 stars from me. I found no faults in this visit. 

If you're from the Sparks/Reno area and you haven't eaten here, you need to. Out of towners....do yourself a solid and check this place out.

i thought the soup was very good, abit strange as I eat a lot of Chinese food but it had great flavor as was the entree but the fried rice was like Uncle Ben's stuff out of the bag. It was not fried rice and moreover I had to pay extra for it. I would say , get some sesame oil, decent rice, cool it until cold and actually fry it, add green onions and green peas and egg and make it like it supposed to be.This is the worst I have ever had.
I loved the nice girls waiting on me who were so pleasant and thoughtful.I will go back as the other was really good.

Food is great but when it's hard to order for pick up.  At least three times recently I've tried to order take out and have been hung up on without having anyone say hello and then going to voice mail when I call back.  They need to get their processes together.  We end up going elsewhere.

On of my absolute favorite restaurants in Nashville! Love the food and the people are amazing. It's really eat to see how they have been able to expand and change their store over time. A real home town success story! The roast-beef is my favorite! Literally could eat here once a week and never get tired of it.

This is my second time coming to this restaurant in, as their location is quite convenient for when I do not wish to walk far for food. The first time I got the Apple walnut salad, no cheese (I am not a goat dairy fan) with salmon. The second time, I got the Apple walnut salad no cheese with salmon. That itself says enough about the place and their salads. 
Cherry tomatoes were on point, the dressing was superb and the Apple slices...amaze-omg. However the star of the salad was the salmon. Can you say yum?? En if not in the salad the salmon would be a great choice cooked with something else. 
Traveling during coronavirus makes it tough to find good food, but if I'm in the mood for a salad I will quickly know where to go.
Best place in town!!!  Great employees! Fantastic food- bar atmosphere is SUPERB!  NO DRAMA!!  Honey walnut & blackened chicken and Pork skillet- FANTASTIC
The food was amazing! Had their shrimp and grits and some of their bread pudding. Best service!

I was visiting family in Indiana when i came across this restaurant. My family and I were pretty excited since in pictures they displayed really good food. The sign they have is that they close  at 2pm. We entered the restaurant at 1:25pm. He said he couldn't help us since they had other reservations. Honestly, that place had a lot of room for just my wife,child, and me. I understand Covid is around, but there's no way that place had no space. Seems like the employees were just lazy. You might as well close at 1:30pm.  Hopefully management sees this. 9/7/2020.

This steamboat is so nice! Who doesn't love a steamboat ? Went for lunch & had a great time. A bit pricey but worth it. The staff is great, good history lesson while on board but not dull and boring & is quick. You get to enjoy the river & boat & the have a live Jazz band. Definitely get onboard while in Nola.

Went here on a Thursday night. Maybe a total of 10 other people in there. Me and a friend sat at the bar. Ordered a rum n coke and a jack and coke. They were good drinks by all means.....but served in a beer mug. Which was strange. We didn't order doubles, but we were def charged for them. Whatever, gets the job done quicker I guess

Ordered food, and it came pretty quickly. My friends tenders were soggy as all hell and clearly old. I got the brisket tacos. BRISKET TACOS. Sounds good, right?! Picture looked amazing. Turns out it's more like pulled pork, and microwaved. Imagine buying a Lloyd brand pulled pork, throwing it in a tortilla and POOF somehow its brisket! 

After bite number 4 or so, I needed more liquor to wash the garbage down. So I order another jack n coke. 15 minutes later, I'm told they are out of Jack. WTH. But ok whatever, she suggests Makers. Ok, sounds good. 5-10 minutes later I'm told they don't have that either. So I then just looked for something I'd like myself. Clearly she has no clue what she has and doesn't. 

About this time, I realize we weren't given any napkins, silverware, nothing. Nothing. 

I was going to chalk it all up to just a bad experience. The waitress/bartender was nice enough, everyone has off days etc. That was the case until I got the bill. Got charged for 3 doubles, but again...I never asked for that. No discount for getting my 3rd choice of drink. No discount for the crappy food. No sorry. Nothing. Just an $80 bill for some crapp

We went there for a quick meeting and the waiter in the "dining room" was overloaded and unimpressive. He approached us as we sat and we said "we need a minute" because we haven't looked at the menu in a while. He ignored us the rest of the time. I know he was overwhelmed but I even got his attention by waving at him and he still ignored us. The bartender Jen was fantastic and Brad, the bus boy, was AWESOME!! They were the only saving grace for our visit because we were unable to order food, waiter ignored us.

Stopped in to use the restroom and left with one of the best Arnold palmers of my life. The group got a mix of donuts, hot chocolate, and coffee. Everything really did taste good and made with some compassion. 10/10 recommend. Maybe I'll come back and try the sliders. They looked beautiful.

Standard Chick-Gil-A greatness here-great food, served quickly, friendly service, great prices.

Like the Terminator, I'll be back.

Service started off slow. But once we finally had a waitress she did a great job. Chips and salsa was very good. They puree the salsa which I love. Food was pretty good, definitely worth another trip

Food: 3/5
Service: 3/5
Ambiance: 3/5

The food is decent. I thought the fried pickles were tasty. The Marci Gras theme is fun. It is nice to see local restaurants/bars doing well in Collinsville. I was happy to see they offered kid's meals. I used the Yelp coupon and was told that it could be used by my waiter. Then the waiter brought over another staff member who told me that I could not use the coupon and it was only for their location. This was done after we ordered and ate the fried pickles. ‍ I had to show her proof of the deal. After proving that the deal was legit, it was honored.

We had a late lunch Saturday. Restaurant nearly empty though most of the patio was full. Food was average and the service less than average but the biggest issue is that the place was filthy. Tables with dishes not bussed, food all over the floor. People not properly sanitizing tables after customers left. It was gross.

We love this spot! Fresh food and friendly faces. The Kofta is my favorite but they have a plethora of dishes to choose from.
The owner always makes us feel welcomed and knows our order when we enter his establishment.

At first glance, I was a little hesitant about the smaller menu, although sometimes fewer choices are better!!

My partner and I split the wings, coconut shrimp, and we each had a burger with fries (yes, lots of food). The fries were crispy to perfection. The burger, ordered medium rare, was juicy and flavorful. Honestly, the best burger I've had in a LONG time. I had room enough for a wing (top notch) and will be saving the coconut shrimp for lunch. The owner (I think) came to check on us and showed us an awesome book of the reconstruction of the restaurant. 

Re: COVID precautions: the restaurant is small, but has the cutest back patio with a TV and heaters. Everyone is 6+ feet away from each other and servers/owners were masked up and cleaned the tables well between each customer. 

I am not in this neighborhood often, but next time I am back I will return to Sutton's.

Two Ten never lets me down. You can taste the passion and effort in both the food and drinks. Great Beer and Sake selection. This crew truly cares about the product they present. The atmosphere is always killer, staff is friendly.

I, and many Nashvillians dream of the Garlic Noodles on a weekly basis. Check out the pickle plate to keep on the table throughout the meal.

I've never even had the ramen (gasp!) That's because I can't help myself from trying many small plates.
Service was extremely quick.  Waitress was very nice.  Should have ordered more, very reasonable prices would certainly come back.  Right near The Palestra

They kept charging me more than what  menu prices was showing first it was with food. Then went to bar they did same. Then i ask at bar she said we just went up on prices. So change menu prices on menus. So I take it personal want go back.

Think of your typical Friday night in your hometown... you want subpar food that offers nothing but average. This is the place for you. The food is acceptable and service sucks. This place is going to be your worst eating experience when you are in New Orleans but hey that's good enough for some people. They are just monopolizing on the name po-boy without actually delivering anything close to the quality a po-boy usually brings. Never will I recommend this place- but it provides food with no wait time and I appreciate that.

I work second shift and pulled up right when they were turning the lights off z was super cool and made me  dinner anyway the other tall guy was really gReat also couldn't ask for better service and the burger and fries I got were really goOd thanks guys.

Holy shit! I just got the turkey cheese steak from this place, based on the great reviews. I'm eating it right now and there is more salt on this thing than in the entire Dead Sea. I can barely tasted the flavor, which I'm sure is there. I hate giving a bad review but I'm disappointed that it didn't live up to the reviews over something so trivial.
Everyone loves their bread. Neat oven right at the door. I've had their lamb chops and seafood. Great restaurant! I can't wait to try more!

They do great work here, and this is one of my two go-to spots in the area for Mexican food. I'm partial to the steak burrito for lunch/dinner or the breakfast burrito with chorizo earlier in the day, but everything I've tried has been excellent. I also love the Mexican rice with peas and carrots,

In addition to the obvious delivery, they offer pickup; as of August 14 they have installed a window for ordering and pickup, so you don't go inside.

Go to taco place when I'm in the area.  Can't go wrong with anything on the menu.  They are generous with the portions and everything is always super fresh.  I usually call in my order before I go there.  It's off the 301 next to the produce stand.  It's easier to park in the Sam's club parking lot and walk through the produce stand.  They also have great produce if you happen to need any.
I guess I thought I would be funny taking off a Star for bullshit reasons. This place is and always has been a 5 star establishment. I apologize for my stupidity.

Noah is the greatest promote this dude
Like 25 of us rolled up an hour til close and he hooked us up ANWAYS

If you have a hard time making a decision, especially when you are hungry, this may not be the place for you.  I find the ordering process here overwhelming and confusing.  There are many different menu signs and lists and it's frustrating that some specialty pizza options are not listed for an easy choice.  The service is somewhat standoffish.  Not exactly helping with my anxiety of ordering something.  I almost walked out.  

The pizza itself is not bad.  Thin crusts topped with whatever you want.  The pizza is ready quickly.. about 8 minutes.  They have outdoor seating and are following good safety procedures.       On Sundays they have kids eat free.  That's pretty cool.
Crab claws (spicy), boudin balls, and daily sausage were all delicious. Boyfriend got the lamb neck, which was huge, but he said it tasted alittle game-y

I'm a big Chipotle fan because of their healthy food options and the fact that each item is customized to each customer's specifications. As someone who always seems to make requests to change items on a menu, I love that Chipotle realizes every customer is unique! 

This location is convenient when in or driving through the Westchase area (but traffic can be bad during afternoon dismissal at the school across the street). I have always found it to be clean and the staff to be friendly and efficient. 

The other day I was looking for something light to eat while running errands, but didn't want a bug meal or traditional fast food. 

Since I was out all day I didn't want leftovers either. I looked over Chipotle's menu for items that would fit my needs. I ordered a kid's size taco meal which ended up being perfect for my needs that day! The meal was served in an adorable box where each item was in it's own compartment! (i forgot to take pics, but take my word, it was adorable!) This way kids can customize their tacos personally - great idea! 

I will keep visiting this location when in the area & suggest you stop by when in Westchase too!

We had been walking down in the French Quarter on the way back to the hotel  so we stopped by this place. We got some nachos and dip de Frijol and it was excellent. I believe both the nachos and the dip was made right there. I got a combo platter Fiesta del Rancho, which was also good.  My daughter got the same thing.  Ours arrived at the same time but my wife's Gordita was missing in action...it only came after we were done with our meals and only after we asked the waiter where it was.

So the place would have gotten a five star but minus the messed up order (strike one) and the fact that we didn't see the waiter until he brought out the food.  Back story... there is about 10 tables in the place ranging in size from 2-6 people, bus about 7-10 seats at the bar.  The place was pretty full and they only had the one waiter and a bartender.  The waiter never came to refill the water glasses or give us more nachos...nothing nix! (Strike 2).  The portions were a little on the small side for my liking.

I got take out (COVID restrictions) for my family and was very pleased with everything. We got the 3 meat platter and king of kings (5 meat platter). Every meat was cooked well, like a real traditional BBQ smokehouse. The ribs are huge and the char on them is great, but they stayed super moist. The pulled pork is very good, the brisket is chopped (not slices) and also wonderful. The smoked chicken was nice but a bit dry (the only thing that was not perfect).  The sauce with it was tangy and mild. 

The sides were interesting. The slaw has a yummy vinegar flavor. The baked beans have a nice cinnamon spice to them. The corn on the cob is buttery and tender. The fries are delicately seasoned and kind of addicting. 

Overall, great food at a nice price. It'll be a great  option for nights when we have a BIG appetite but don't want to cook.
Place was unbelievably good. Simple menu great milkshakes

Nona took over a space that has seen a lot of restaurants come and go, some of whom were pretty good. But it's hard to imagine a better fit for this Main Street  site than this pizza place. We only had the margherita and the garlic knots but I hope to try the others over time. 

It's well worth it, with the best margherita I can recall ever having  a nd great service even on a busy night. I hope you guys last because we'll be back.

Everything we had was beautifully plated and absolutely scrumptious. We tried 5 small plates ranging from the sushi grade scallops to tacos or ox tail. And I give each a 10. The drinks are interesting... not hard alcohol but not virgin. Tasted great and everyone could drive home after. This is one of my new favorite spots for tapas-style dining.
This was the worst service ever and the food was dry and burnt eVen the fries where burnt! We waited  on it for over a hour and a half half of are party cancelled there food and left! Don't go !

Being born and raised in an Italian family and growing up in New Jersey it's kinda hard to find Italian food out especially in Louisiana. This restaurant wasn't bad at all. My husband ordered the chicken Parmesan and it was good. I got a salad because I didn't want to eat heavy. The salad was also pretty good. The main reason I picked this spot for dinner that night was because it had crock French onion soup. Which is not easy to find at restaurants here. All the reviews and pictures of the soup we good. Unfortunately, I was disappointed when mine came out and I tasted it. Not the best but also not the worst I have had. It's a cute little restaurant and the wait staff was very nice.

The food was good!
Service was good!
Wait time was horrible! 
Nothing in particular stuck out to me to earn anything higher then three stars. 
My wife agreed.

I loves me a good street taco, and this little divey mom and pop shop gives it a good go. Maybe I came on an off day, because they were certainly earnest enough.  I was warned it was pretty bare bones, and that doesn't sway me.  The woman manning the tables was genuinely very sweet and nice and accommodated all our special requests. 

First off, cash only. Got that?

We split two tacos bistek @ $.250 each and a sope con carnitas ($6), then ordered a soda. Total $13.  The problem?  The meats were dried out and a little tough. Disappointing because the tortillas were all probably handmade and delicious, and the salsa verde they provided was delicious with a bit of a kick.

I'd like to come back and give it another try and will update accordingly.

Six years ago I was wrong, this place clearly deserves five stars. 

I was looking for Chinese Egg Noodles at Oceanic Oriental Market next door so I decided to drop in to do a little bit of work. I quickly perused the menu and decided on avocado toast, basic, I know. What caught me off guard was it is only $3.75. Um, what?!

When it came out I was super impressed. It is basically an avocado sandwich. There is cream cheese, tomato, and avocado, on what I think is cuban bread. It was absolutely delicious and the perfect snack, or lunch for those of you with smaller appetites. 

The inside is small, but it was pretty empty at noon on a Thursday. I was lucky enough to be next to an outlet so I plugged my laptop in and got some work done. Parking can be a pain, but there is a lot by Oceanic Oriental Market, so I'm hoping it was kosher that I parked there! 

They have water sitting out so you can keep refilling a cup for yourself. I love staying hydrated. 

The workers seemed super friendly and I just really enjoyed this chill atmosphere. I will definitely be back.

Service is fast, food is great. Prices are very reasonable. The portions are huge.  The Boston clam chowder is fantastic. The decor is dated and it's a bit dark but staff are wonderful. Always a great experience.
We came here on a bachelorette party for the live music and had so much fun! Everyone was so friendly, management was so amazing and gracious and the music was fantastic! Will definitely be back!

Quaint place. Be ready to walk a good bit unless you're on a lucky streak. The food itself is very good, but not what myself and company were looking for. While we hoped for a regular biscuit and chicken sandwich, the food was more of a piece of half dark half white meat chicken sandwiched between two pancakes. While moderately priced food, the drinks were slightly overpriced. Before you pay $5 for the orange juice, be sure to look up how much 9oz really is.

Overall, fine place but just not what we were looking for.

Best,
-Michael

The food was good but service was terrible. We waited 50 minutes even though we had a reservation. The service at the table was so slow and not attentive at all. Drink orders were forgotten. Go somewhere else given all of the options in the area.

I almost wasn't going to write this review because I feel bad giving it 3 stars again. After thinking about it for a few days, I figured I might as well write it. I had high hopes that I would have been able to rate this place higher than 3 stars. I got the General Tso's chicken with white rice for dinner a few nights ago. It was $12.67, and firstly, the woman on the phone told me that this would come with an egg roll and salad. It did not.

I'm going to be honest and say that I rarely ever crave Chinese food these days and the last time that I had General Tso's chicken was probably over a year ago. But back when I used to eat Chinese food much more, I loved this dish. And I can't remember it being so sweet. This tasted like dessert chicken, honestly. It was scary how sweet this chicken tasted. And the sauce was an unappealing thick and gloppy texture.

After I scraped off most of the goopy sauce from the chicken pieces, the chicken actually tasted pretty good. The few bits of broccoli that came with the dish were actually perfect because they added a crunchy element not found elsewhere in the dish. Overall, I would not order this dish again. The sauce was a no-go for me. Side note, I enjoyed the single fortune cookie that I received. And, I didn't get any utensils. LOL. I remember from last time that this place is notoriously cheap on fortune cookies, utensils, and napkins.

My Boyfriend and I recently celebrated our anniversary here and I'm so glad we did! The meats were all really good especially the garlic steak and bacon wrapped chicken and my favourites were the shrimp and grilled pineapple, I would say the shrimp  were the best I ever tasted! Nice options in the hot and cold buffet, I really enjoyed the mash potatoes and I liked the truffle macaroni. It's a smaller restaurant, casual style with a nice view, service was really good, it was a overall really nice experience and I will be back for sure!

What an amazing establishment! The proprietors a husband and wife team are on point from decor to service! We were just visiting for a conference and wanted an experience in local culture and we got it. We started with Jerk wings which melted In your mouth as they fell off the bone. Next up Coco sweet bread amazing! More please! My husband and I shared the Jerk chicken platter, again unbelievable flavor and portions. We finished with Rum cake which had just come out of the oven.....No words! When you follow your dreams because your passionate about food and service and sharing your culture through food with others you wind up with Yah Mon! Thank you‼

I was there in December and got a $30 gift card and a meal. The gift card was a Christmas present and they tried to use it twice in Port Richey.  The first time the owner said they weren't set up for the gift card yet. They went the other day and he said there wasn't anything on the gift card.  That was a $30 gift card I do not have the receipt but it is on my credit card for 38+ change whatever the meal was. This is very poor poor customer service. I know when I got the gift card the guy ringing me out had to ask somebody else how to do it.      We were so looking forward to the one in Port Richey opening up and I hate to say we will never be back

This restaurant always comes on my radar when I visit Clearwater , so today I needed to make it a point to finally try it , so happy I did . I went with my three children who also really enjoyed their meals . I love how everything is gluten free , organic produce and grass fed meats .. so important . Not only is the food amazing , our server Matt was above and beyond ... extremely knowledgeable and personable . My boys kept saying how great Matt is . Thank you Matt and thank you Kara Lynn for a wonderful meal . We will be back :)
My favorite Jamaican food in Nashville and very reasonable prices. I recommend the large white plate (fiyah spice level) w/ Jamaican rice and peas, and plantains!

OMG the red Savin is so hot my face watered from every hole. So hot but with a flavor that makes the you keep eating. Paired with a IPA hell yeah. Right off the interstate in a strip set of shops. Don't sleep on this place it is fire!
This was my first experience at this restaurant. The service was excellent. Friendly staff including the manager, hostesses and waiters. Food was fabulous!!
Had a yummy, yummy salad. I upgraded the salad to come in a tostada shell and it was perfect! Salad has a sweet dressing and it was so delicious that I requested extra dressing.
I like the atmosphere, but not the food. Ordered the cheese platter and it was not good. (cheap cheese) not impressed. Would not go back for the food.

I was so so excited to go to this place! It was beautiful and they followed guidelines with Covid-19 very well. We go the menu and saw that it was scaled back quite a lot to the point where there was only: seafood options, salads with no protein, a Mediterranean burger. No chicken, no beef, no other options for protein. Our guest of honor did not eat seafood or lamb (in the burger) so we decided to have drinks and an appetizer and discuss our plan. We ordered 3 rum punches (doubles) and a french fry appetizer. We got a bill for $75 for these 4 items. At first we called the server back because it looked like they double charged us for our drinks, but nope they were $20 a piece for the rum punches (normally $10). I understand up-charges on drinks, but $20 for a fruity drink that was a WELL drink?? I've never been anywhere that I was charged double in an instance like this. Straight shots of liquor, I get it.  umm no thanks. AND the fries were awful, barely warm and mostly burnt. It's unlikely with this experience I will going back for a full meal. Sorry Vessel but that was not a $20 drink and now it will cost losing a potential patron. Ambiance was nice but not worth the $$$

We decide to try this new chinese restaurant. To our wonderful delight the food was very close to traditional as I have had since my visit to China. We ordered steamed chicken dumplings , roast pork buns, chicken on a stick, Singapore rice noodles and roast duck over rice.oh and all the free you can drink. This is a BYOB. I will.be back and bringing some friends. A gem in Horsham
